purpose: Re-encode previously frozen Vegeta S3 pre-execution coverage gates for exact-ground-truth re-evaluation. This file introduces no new performance or topology-fidelity thresholds.
policy_note: Do not relax these thresholds based on exact-ground-truth performance. Aggregate conflict and block-balanced conflict coverage are recomputed on the exact source corpus; semantic transaction/frame coverage is read from the already-frozen translation coverage report.

aggregate_source_conflict_coverage.basis: previously frozen source conflict-pair coverage gate

median_conflict_bearing_block_coverage.basis: previously frozen block-balanced source conflict coverage gate

semantic_transaction_coverage.basis: previously frozen semantic transaction coverage gate

semantic_call_frame_coverage.basis: previously frozen semantic call-frame coverage gate
